title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 current zero-event part 1
notes: Built from fresh canonical main after #306. Current-main entity/product identities were used instead of the stale Wave 03 queue. Publication/discovery dates are not represented as product release dates unless the primary source explicitly documents a release.

events.title: Prokey Optimum firmware v1.10.5 released
events.description: The official Prokey Optimum firmware repository published firmware v1.10.5 on 2023-10-09 with support for OKChain Token, providing dated first-party lifecycle evidence for the Prokey Optimum hardware wallet.

events.title: Zerion Wallet added TRON support
events.description: Zerion announced on 2026-01-08 that TRON was live in Zerion Wallet, enabling users to buy TRX and TRC-20 USDT and send or store TRON assets alongside the wallet's other supported chains.

events.title: Arculus documented Wallet 3.12.x as the current release
events.description: Arculus's official software and hardware update documentation identified Wallet 3.12.x as the current release by 2026-08-23 and listed 3.12.0 features including historical coin charts, Tempo and HyperEVM support, TON Connect, AXL staking, address export, active trustline views, and a Yield/Earn tab. This record uses the source publication date as a conservative discovery date and does not assert that 3.12.0 itself was released on that day.

events.title: Casa documented address whitelisting for vaults
events.description: Casa published first-party documentation on 2026-06-29 describing address whitelisting as an available security feature that restricts outgoing vault transactions to pre-approved addresses and applies across enabled vaults.

events.title: OneKey Wallet 6.5.2 released
events.description: The official OneKey app monorepo published OneKey Wallet 6.5.2 on 2026-08-21 with signed packaged wallet builds across Android and desktop platforms. The current canonical product list models OneKey Pro hardware but not the software app as its own product, so this lifecycle event is intentionally entity-level and is not attached to OneKey Pro.

evidence.title: Prokey Firmware v1.10.5
evidence.notes: Official Prokey Optimum firmware GitHub release.

evidence.title: Zerion Wallet Integrates TRON to Support the Mass Adoption of Stablecoin Payments
evidence.notes: First-party Zerion announcement states TRON is live in Zerion Wallet.

evidence.title: Arculus Wallet New Features
evidence.notes: First-party support documentation identifies 3.12.x as the current release; publication date is used only as discovery chronology.

evidence.title: Address Whitelisting in Casa
evidence.notes: First-party Casa documentation describes whitelisting as available for vault transactions.

evidence.title: OneKey Wallet 6.5.2
evidence.notes: Official OneKey app monorepo release with packaged Android and desktop wallet builds; intentionally entity-level in WLR.
